films: HOW TO BREAK OFF AN ENGAGEMENT
beats: Dim bedroom; Poet reads to an averted Ex
Ex falls, Poet follows into clouds
Romantic slow motion and light leaks
Photographs, film and fiction as memory inserts
Floor opens; Poet falls into black
Poet floats in black under flashes
Young Poet watches headlights sweep the room
Parents argue inside a parked car
Object enters chapel through intact window
Empty chapel: pews, choir, baptism pool
Heart floats from shore into Poet
Follow a trail uphill toward the field
Golden plants turn toward Poet; weeds withdraw
Search bare ground for lost hands
Childhood basement, shared mattress, southern wood
Blood and fingerprints carry ancestral power
Voiceover stops; wander toward a house
Bands diverge; home splits; eleven petals
Soul leaves body and watches from above
Overhead Atlantis, blue and pink lights
Angels pour cleansing water over dancing body
Crowds admire Poet; Ex appears and is unreachable
Poet and Ex walk under the moon
Suitcases, phone booth, call to Mother
Mother and Poet watch Poet and Ex break up
Street becomes living room; breakup remains
Mother disappears; Father answers and appears
Father and son walk while breakup persists
Poet touches steel and mounts motorcycle
Ride through Atlantis, buildings and lights streak
Mountain ride, birds and first light
Return to chapel shore and dismount
Modern white temple builds with Poet
Journal becomes blueprint, words are spoken
Completed temple and Poet in sunlight
Friends embrace, laugh and share memories
Walk from temple along harbor to cafe
Couple beside water on Jupiter’s moon
Poet rises from cafe, walks alone
Harbor, temple, Atlantis dissolve into haze
Haze climbs reluctant Poet; float in black
Floating alternates with life’s highs and lows
Return to vintage party in slow motion
Poet disappears into crowd; door closes
